sources.snippet: Phantom has developed a unified video generation framework for single and multi-subject references based on both Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B and Wan2.1-T2V-14B. Please refer to their examples. UniAnimate-DiT, based on Wan2.1-14B-I2V, has trained a Human image animation model and has open-sourced the inference and training code. Feel free to enjoy it!
